name: use-announcements
title: useAnnouncements
description: useAnnouncements: the announcements block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the announcements block (`npx better-supabase add announcements`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/announcements.
